title: Business Account Volume Rate Schedule for Northgate Purchases & Returns Business Restocking
content:
Commercial pricing schedule for the business restocking charge on a changed-mind return of special-order merchandise bought through Northgate Purchases & Returns on a Northgate Business Membership or Northgate Business Plus Membership. The rate depends on the member's Northgate Credit Cards business card and the Northgate purchases charged to it.

## Business account volume rate

When the member holds an active Northgate Rewards Visa Business or Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus and the Northgate purchases on that card's statements of the last 12 months total 25000.00 or more, the business restocking rate is 9 percent; when the member holds such an active card and those purchases total at least 10000.00 but less than 25000.00, the business restocking rate is 12 percent; otherwise the business restocking rate is the channel's own restocking fee percentage.

The card is the member's Northgate Credit Cards account in status active; the purchases counted are the qualifying spend in the Northgate purchases category on the statement reward entries of that card dated within the last 12 months.

| Active card held | Northgate purchases on its statements, last 12 months (USD) | Business restocking rate |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business or Business Plus | 25000.00 or more | 9 percent |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business or Business Plus | at least 10000.00, less than 25000.00 | 12 percent |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business or Business Plus | less than 10000.00 | the channel's own restocking fee percentage |
| no active business card | any amount | the channel's own restocking fee percentage |

## Thresholds on both sides (hypothetical card histories)

| Card | Last 12 months | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| active Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus | 25000.00 | 9 percent |
| active Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus | 24999.99 | 12 percent |
| active Northgate Rewards Visa Business | 10000.00 | 12 percent |
| active Northgate Rewards Visa Business | 9999.99 | the channel's own restocking fee percentage |
| a closed Northgate Rewards Visa Business | 40000.00 | the channel's own restocking fee percentage |
